āmo: Confession (ein: means yes(word of assent, be true, right, etc.).

āmodati: [Ā+muda+a+ti] (kri) CL=8 I am delight .who was happy from the beginning.
āmodayanta: [Ā+muda+ṇaya+anta] (ti) CL=8 who is to be delight; he.

āmāyadāsī: [Āmā+dāsī] (thī) CL=8 A slave (in pregnant state) in the womb of a maid; a female slave who was born in his master home and his mother also a maid.
